page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Cloning vectors defined
steps.margin_note: Definition with both the carrying and the copying.
lines: A CLONING VECTOR is a DNA molecule used to
CARRY a foreign DNA fragment into a host cell, where
It must be able to replicate inside the host.
steps.why: A carrier that could not replicate would deliver the gene once and no more, so self replication is part of the definition.
common_mistakes: Saying a vector is the host. The vector is the CARRIER; the host is the cell.
Leaving out replication. A vector must copy itself inside the host.
steps.memory_tip: It carries the gene in and then copies it.

Leaving out the Ti plasmid. It is the plant vector, and this is a botany paper.
